headline: Costco presented initial plans for a Coslin Drive warehouse and fueling station, while boards prepped warrant articles for Special Town Meeting.
synopsis: The Planning Board opened a public hearing on Costco Wholesale's proposed 167,000-square-foot warehouse and 30-position gas station on Coslin Drive, where residents raised traffic concerns along Route 9 and surrounding neighborhood streets. The Planning Board also continued discussions on a two-family dwelling zoning amendment scheduled for the upcoming Special Town Meeting. Meanwhile, the Trails Committee weighed floor amendments to salvage funding for the Peninsula Trail pedestrian bridge after the article failed to win recommendations from the Select Board and Advisory Committee.

highlights.title: Costco outlines Coslin Drive warehouse and fueling station plans
highlights.why: Costco presented preliminary site layouts and traffic data for a 167,000-square-foot retail store and 30-pump gas station, drawing traffic and safety concerns from nearby residents.

highlights.title: Trails Committee weighs floor amendment for Peninsula Trail bridge
highlights.why: After the Select Board and Advisory Committee voted not to recommend Article 4, the committee debated reducing its new CPA funding request to $25,000 and repurposing $211,000 in existing funds.

highlights.title: Two-family dwelling zoning article debated ahead of Town Meeting
highlights.why: The Planning Board reviewed text adjustments to clarify lot size requirements across zoning districts and remove terms like duplex and townhouse before the warrant article goes to voters.

highlights.title: Trails Committee coordinates fall events and hunting safety
highlights.why: The committee arranged safety protocols, including blaze orange vests for hikers, to account for youth hunting season during upcoming trail walks and yoga sessions.

highlights.title: Fay School reviews landscaping plan for occupancy approval
highlights.why: Representatives outlined native plantings and pesticide restrictions required to resolve conditions and secure a final certificate of occupancy for a school building addition.

looking_ahead.what: Joint meeting with Elementary School Building Committee and town boards at Public Safety Building
Special Town Meeting and continued two-family dwelling hearing
